generation_command.h2: python scripts/build_xiangqi_h2.py (see history/validation_report.json for inputs and engine hashes)
generation_command.c2_candidates: python scripts/extract_ccpd_positions.py --source "$CCPD_ROOT" --output tmp/c2-positions.jsonl --tail-plies 1000 --max-games 2000; python scripts/generate_xiangqi_c2_candidates.py --positions tmp/c2-positions.jsonl --source "$CCPD_ROOT" --output tmp/c2-candidates.json --report tmp/c2-generation.json --seed 20260831 --workers 6 --max-pieces 18

model_service_snapshot: Evaluation configuration records model name, thinking flag and provider settings per run; no API key is persisted.
contamination_policy: CCPD is public. Exact training-data contamination cannot be established locally; disclose this limitation and the provider policy for every model.

intentional_overlap.D3_M2: All 250 FENs are intentionally shared to isolate modality.
intentional_overlap.C2: Each of 60 paired scenarios intentionally repeats one FEN across four rule cards.

previous_release.migration_policy: Legacy ID mapping targets only the immutable legacy archive; no old answers are attached to replaced boards.

engine.local_validation_environment: WSL Python invoking official Windows universal binary

validation.variants: independent reference rules and exhaustive depth-3 root utility comparison

interpretation.c2: fixed three-ply tactical utility, not global optimality
interpretation.h2: strict mate against the fixed opponent; two reference lines are not an all-defence or shortest-mate proof
interpretation.history_visual_gaps: task performance changes, not separate memory or recognition accuracy
